title: Regression(SectionList): Unable to add style like { flex: 1 } to the ListEmptyComponent

labels.name: Impact: Regression
labels.description: Describes a behavior that used to work on a prior release, but stopped working recently.

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body:
## 💥 Regression Report
Since the commit [#e94d344](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/commit/e94d344#diff-25477c6bad509193f026645fd928dec6R888) adding a `{ flex: 1 }`  to the `SectionList`'s `ListEmptyComponent` prop is not taken into account anymore.  
The commit adds a wrapper around the ListEmptyComponent which is no longer stylable.

## Last working version
Worked up to version:
0.59.2

Stopped working in version:
0.59.3

## To Reproduce
Add a component like `<View style={{ flex: 1 }} />` as a ListEmptyComponent, it will not take  the full height.

## Expected Behavior
I expect to have the RN <= 0.59.2's behavior which allowed us to add `{ flex: 1 }` to use the full height.

## Code Example
```js
<SectionList
  sections={this.props.sections}
  keyExtractor={this.keyExtractor}
  renderItem={this.renderItem}
  contentContainerStyle={{ flex: 1 }}
  ListEmptyComponent={(
    <View style={{
        flex: 1, // This one won't works
        backgroundColor: 'red'
      }}
    />
  )}
/> 
```
